name: The Praya Grande, Macau, with the fort of S. Pedro
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view across the Praya Grande ('Great Bay'), Macau; on the right is a group of boat-people beside the small fort of S. Pedro,with  the Portuguese flag aloft. Across the bay is Penha Hill, with a wall leading from Fort Bomparto at the water's edge up to the convent on the summit of the hill.
